Chapter 556: Chapter 9: The Door to the Myriad Realms Trembles Again (Please Subscribe)_2

Not only was he unable to contend with the Galactic Star Lord, but if he continued to stay, there was a risk of stumbling if the Galactic Star Lord seized an opportunity.

“What a pity…”

Lin Yuan’s expression was calm, but he felt a tinge of regret inside.

In the opening of Spatial Layers, Lin Yuan was not as skilled as Maduo Traveler.

However, the world within Lin Yuan was vast, with a circumference of over a hundred million li, and the power that burst forth was estimated to have surpassed the prowess of a Million Heavy Realm.

Nevertheless, Maduo Traveler was very cautious. Though he was angry, he had not lost his reason and did not completely underestimate Lin Yuan.

...

Otherwise, with that last contact collision, Lin Yuan had the confidence to make the other party suffer a significant loss.

“Galactic Star Lord, let’s end this matter here,” Maduo Traveler immediately conceded, understanding that with the strength Lin Yuan had just shown, he had no hope of obtaining that treasure.

“Here’s a heads up: ‘Hunyi’ of the Tianyu Clan is searching for you everywhere, wanting to kill this avatar of yours to avenge the battlefield,” he said.

“‘Hunyi’ is the strongest Ninth Rank life of the Tianyu Clan in this era, having opened over thirty million Spatial Layers. Even though you’re strong, when facing ‘Hunyi,’ you won’t even be able to flee,” Maduo Traveler immediately said, providing some secret information to ease the relationship with the Galactic Star Lord.

Now that he confirmed that the treasure was out of his reach, it was natural not to completely offend the Galactic Star Lord.

After speaking, Maduo Traveler’s figure merged into a deeper layer of Spatial Layers and flew off in another direction.

Lin Yuan stood still and did not pursue.

The main issue was that he could not catch up.

The more Spatial Layers opened, the more layers one could occupy in an instant, and one could appear amidst the myriad layers in a split second.

In terms of raw killing power, Lin Yuan surpassed the warriors of the Million Heavy Realm, but in other aspects, he was somewhat inferior.

Normally, with the help of certain Secret Techniques and treasures, beings of lower Spatial Layer count can hope to escape the pursuit of those from higher layer counts.

For example, Xilan had just escaped with her life from Maduo Traveler’s hands.

But for a being from a lower number of Spatial Layers to attempt to kill a being from a higher number of layers… setting aside the question of strength, such an event was not possible.

The chases between Ninth Rank strong beings across Spatial Layers were not directly related to speed.

“‘Hunyi’ of the Tianyu Clan?” Lin Yuan thought of Maduo Traveler’s reminder, his expression becoming slightly solemn.

A normal Ninth Rank being needs only to open ten million Spatial Layers, which is the threshold for attempting a breakthrough to the Tenth Rank, but ‘Hunyi’ has opened more than thirty million layers…

His strength is absolutely above that of other Ninth Rank beings, and it is estimated that among the many Ninth Rank beings entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm this time, ‘Hunyi’ is definitely one of the strongest.

“However, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is so vast, it won’t be easy to find me,” Lin Yuan said, shaking his head lightly. Indeed, he was no match for ‘Hunyi,’ but this strongest Ninth Rank of the Tianyu Clan could not directly pinpoint Lin Yuan’s location.

…..

Deep within the myriad Spatial Layers.

Maduo Traveler, who had already departed, still felt a bit of lingering fear and unease.

“I’ve got in over my head,” he said.

“If I had known the Galactic Star Lord was so powerful, I should have decisively given up on that treasure from the outset,” Maduo Traveler began to reflect on his actions.

His Ancient God Ancestor, among many Ancient Gods, was not the strongest in terms of power, but he thrived by maintaining good relationships with various clans.

This was achieved because he offended no one.

But now, he had offended the Galactic Star Lord.

“Still, the piece of intelligence I revealed should make up for it to some extent…” Maduo Traveler sighed slightly with relief.

The fact that ‘Hunyi’ was searching for the Galactic Star Lord was not widely known; Maduo Traveler, through his Ancient God Ancestor’s relationships, was one of the few who were informed.

‘Hunyi’ promised compensation for whoever could provide the whereabouts of the Galactic Star Lord.

But at this point, Maduo Traveler couldn’t care less about any reward; he was only thinking of how to redeem himself in the eyes of the Galactic Star Lord, not to seek favor but at least to avert disgust.

…..

After Maduo Traveler retreated,

Lin Yuan returned to Xilan’s side.

“It’s safe now,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

“Maduo Traveler has retreated?” Xilan couldn’t help asking.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Your strength, Galactic Star Lord…” Even with some anticipation, Xilan still felt shocked.

Maduo Traveler’s temperament was far from that of his Ancient God Ancestor; he was impulsive and prone to getting in over his head.

The only way to make Maduo Traveler retreat on his own was to inflict pain, to make him lose the will to continue the confrontation.

By achieving this, Lin Yuan, who drove Maduo Traveler away, must possess strength at least above that of Maduo Traveler.

Maduo Traveler had opened up more than nine hundred thousand Spatial Layers, approaching the Ninth Rank Millionfold Realm. If Lin Yuan is even stronger than Maduo Traveler, could it be…

Xilan vaguely felt her own cognition being shattered.

She has been in the Ninth Rank for nearly a million years, and the Spatial Layers she opened up were only over six hundred thousand, far weaker than Maduo Traveler.

But now, Lin Yuan, who had recently ascended to the Ninth Rank, was already capable of surpassing Maduo Traveler?

“Let’s not talk about this anymore.”

“Let’s go elsewhere.”

Lin Yuan, leading Xilan, entered the layers of Spatial Layers.

Several days later.

The two finally stopped.

“Maduo Traveler said the ‘Hunyi’ of the Tianyu Clan is looking for my whereabouts.” Lin Yuan spoke directly.

“Hunyi?” Xilan’s face changed slightly.

Toward this strongest ninth-rank member of the Tianyu Clan, she began to feel extremely wary and even fearful.

In the Large Alien Battlefield, scenes of Hunyi’s strikes swept through tens of millions of Spatial Layers, suppressing dozens of Ninth Rank cultivators of the Myriad Heavy Realm to near death.

Such a powerful being was actually looking for Lin Yuan’s whereabouts?

Xilan’s expression turned unsightly.

This was too shameless.

Although Lin Yuan indeed caused the Tianyu Clan great embarrassment on the battlefield,

it still didn’t justify deploying such a powerful being specifically against him.

“We will need to be more cautious from now on.” Xilan steadied herself and spoke earnestly.

“Of course.” Lin Yuan said.

Even without Hunyi, he would tread carefully in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“By the way.”

“Tell me about that opportune place, what made Maduo Traveler so angry?” Lin Yuan asked with slight curiosity.

Maduo Traveler, always trying to emulate his crafty ‘Ancient God’ Ancestor, wouldn’t easily make enemies of any party.

That he would go to such lengths to hunt down Xilan, clearly, he must have been truly enraged.

“Hahaha.”

Upon hearing this, Xilan’s face revealed a smile.

“That opportune place was left by a follower of ‘His Majesty’…” Xilan immediately said.

To Lin Yuan, she had nothing to hide.

If it weren’t for Lin Yuan, she would still be hunted by Maduo Traveler, and it’s possible this Avatar might already be dead.

“‘His Majesty’?”

Lin Yuan nodded, listening.

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, there were many mentions of ‘His Majesty’ among the various opportunities.

Most owners of treasures at these opportune places were followers of that great ‘His Majesty’.

“This follower came from a mysterious background, accidentally entering a dimensional rift and falling into our dimension. Ultimately, he was saved by ‘His Majesty’.”

Xilan’s tone carried some astonishment; discussions of dimensional layers were not a secret.

Dimensional layers, which are above Space Rules, even Twelfth-Rank Life, Supreme Beings, ultimate existences on the Dao, can’t break through dimensional layers.

But between different dimensions, there’s a very slim chance rifts can occur, and if one enters these rifts and survives, there’s a chance to enter other dimensions.

However, the chances were so slim that even Supreme Beings couldn’t detect the existence of dimensional rifts, and once rifts appeared, they would vanish within a few breaths.

“What I received, according to the owner of that place of chance, is their most cherished treasure.”

Xilan extended her right hand, and a black sphere appeared before her.

The black sphere hovered in midair, slowly rotating, emanating mysterious fluctuations.

“But I’ve studied it for a long time and haven’t discovered what’s special about this treasure?” Xilan’s expression was puzzled.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan, who was initially just a bit curious, now wore a serious expression.

Because at the same time,

the grandiose and magnificent Door to the Myriad Realms deep within his mind began to tremble slightly.
